title: Classifying special quadrilaterals by their properties
summary: Classify quadrilaterals from sides, angles, diagonals and symmetry.
objectives: Classify special quadrilaterals from their sides, angles and parallel sides.
Use diagonal and symmetry properties to distinguish related quadrilaterals.
Explain the hierarchy linking squares, rectangles, rhombi and parallelograms.

blocks.text: A square is both a rectangle and a rhombus. Rectangles and rhombi are parallelograms. A kite has two pairs of adjacent equal sides, while a trapezium has one pair of parallel sides in this course classification.
